about_the_game:
"Farm Life" is an arcade puzzle game that will transport you to the incredible world of farming!
Imagine vibrant 3D graphics unfolding before you like a painting brought to life under the sun's rays.
The colorful landscapes of the farm captivate your gaze, instantly immersing you in an atmosphere of tranquility and joy!
But this isn't just a game about farming; it’s a true gem for puzzle lovers!

The intuitive gameplay allows you to easily and enjoyably interact with the surrounding world.
Simply click on the objects that match the required shapes, and you’ll progress through the levels!
Each new mission is a chance to showcase your skills and solve unique challenges, collecting various items and completing interesting tasks.

Features:

3D graphics
Intuitive gameplay
Engaging missions
Interesting locations

"Farm Life" gives you the chance to be part of farm life, savoring every moment and experiencing true enjoyment from solving puzzles.
Discover all its exciting features today!
